2607.03350.title: LLM-Enhanced Hierarchical Heterogeneous Graph Representation Learning for Malicious Python Package Detection
2607.03350.paper_summary: Malicious Python packages have become a major threat to software supply chain ecosystems due to the widespread adoption of open-source repositories such as PyPI. Existing learning-based detection methods struggle to capture the hierarchical organization and heterogeneous interactions among different program entities. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code understanding and semantic reasoning, they are rarely integrated with structural program representations for fine-grained malicious behavior analysis. In this paper, we propose an LLM-enhanced hierarchical heterogeneous graph representation learning framework for malicious Python package detection. The framework constructs a hierarchical heterogeneous code graph that explicitly models heterogeneous code entities and different types of structural dependencies. LLMs are further leveraged to infer function-level semantic roles, introducing an additional layer of semantic heterogeneity. Based on this graph, we develop a hierarchical heterogeneous graph neural network that performs type-aware message passing over different node and edge categories, effectively modeling malicious behavior propagation for accurate package-level classification. The framework also incorporates a function-level attribution mechanism which, combined with LLM reasoning, automatically identifies suspicious functions and localizes fine-grained malicious behaviors without human expert intervention. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that our framework consistently outperforms traditional machine learning methods, graph-based detectors, and state-of-the-art LLMs across packages with varying sizes and dependency complexities, while providing accurate, robust, and interpretable malicious behavior localization.
2607.03350.paper_summary_zh: 惡意的 Python 套件已成為軟體供應鏈生態系統的一大威脅，這主要是因為開源資料庫如 PyPI 的廣泛採用。現有的基於學習的檢測方法難以捕捉不同程式實體之間的階層組織和異質互動。儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）在程式碼理解和語義推理方面展現出強大的能力，但它們很少與結構化程式表示結合，以進行細緻的惡意行為分析。在本文中，我們提出了一個增強 LLM 的階層異質圖表示學習框架，用於惡意 Python 套件檢測。該框架構建了一個階層異質程式碼圖，明確建模異質程式碼實體和不同類型的結構依賴關係。進一步利用 LLM 推斷函數級別的語義角色，引入了額外的語義異質性層。基於這個圖，我們開發了一個階層異質圖神經網絡，對不同的節點和邊類別執行類型感知的消息傳遞，有效地建模惡意行為的傳播，以實現準確的套件級別分類。該框架還包含一個函數級別的歸因機制，結合 LLM 推理，自動識別可疑函數並定位細緻的惡意行為，而無需人類專家的介入。在真實世界數據集上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，我們的框架在不同大小和依賴複雜度的套件中，始終優於傳統機器學習方法、基於圖的檢測器和最先進的 LLM，同時提供準確、穩健且可解釋的惡意行為定位。
